Burner surface 0.3 m x 0.3 m = 0.09 m2 at z = 0.5 m, so HRRPUA = 110/0.09 ≈ 1222 kW/m2. This is within 250–2500 and matches the NBS reference.
HRR curve: 0 → 110 kW in 1 s, held until 900 s, then extinguished at 901 s. The hrr_curve takes precedence over growth/time_to_peak_s.
Methane fuel CH4: heat of combustion 50,000 kJ/kg, soot yield 0.005 (as in the NBS reference) and CO yield 0 (FDS default, clean gas burner).
The burner pedestal is modelled in steel (pan), like the reference case.

The partition wall, its door, the solid block, the access-corridor ceiling and the slab above the fire room are in ceramic fibre (fire-room envelope). The rest uses the building default material: calcium silicate on plasterboard.
The fire-room floor is in ceramic fibre as requested (the original test used refractory brick).
The fill block for the unused zone has the default material. It lies outside the computed meshes, so it has no thermal effect.
Device output every 1 s and slice output every 5 s (spec defaults); default French thresholds profile (fr_default).
No mechanical extraction and no make-up air: natural ventilation only, through the door at the end of the corridor.
